body: Adversarial review round 7 (codex): extractAgySection now rejects alphanumeric and dot-digit suffixes but still accepts a hyphen suffix, so a 1.4.7-beta heading is hashed and attested as 1.4.7. Extend the boundary lookahead in skills/modernize/scripts/audit.mjs and skills/modernize/scripts/trust-anchor.mjs (identical behaviour) to also reject a hyphen followed by an alphanumeric. Add regression tests to test/trust-anchor.test.mjs (1.4.7-beta, 1.4.7-rc.1 rejected; a bracketed or space-terminated exact heading still matches). Sync mirrors with npm run skills:sync. Acceptance: npm test green; the new tests fail without the fix.
title: Reject prerelease headings in the release-section extractor
